user.title: Set up HA ANT+
user.description: Set up HA ANT+. Local ANT+ USB adapters and remote ANT+ gateways are detected and used automatically.

usb_confirm.title: ANT+ USB adapter discovered
usb_confirm.description: Set up HA ANT+ with the discovered adapter {name}? Remote ANT+ gateways will also be accepted automatically.

error.adapter_not_found: No ANT+ USB adapter was found. Make sure it is connected and accessible to Home Assistant.
error.adapter_in_use: The ANT+ USB adapter is already in use by another process.
error.permission_denied: Home Assistant does not have permission to access the ANT+ USB adapter.
error.cannot_start: The ANT+ USB adapter was found, but ANT+ communication could not be started. Check the Home Assistant logs.

init.title: HA ANT+ options
init.description: Live metrics become unavailable after the configured inactivity timeout. Slow/device diagnostic values remain available while the ANT+ device is still being received.
